title: Esquie - Expedition 33 Character Guide & Lore
description: Esquie in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - the mythical mount whose Swim, Dive, Climb and Fly abilities gate areas of the map, and how to unlock each.

sections.title: Who They Are
sections.content: Esquie is not a party member but a mount whose abilities gate areas of the map: Swim crosses water, Dive opens underwater routes, Climb reaches high ground, and Fly unlocks late-game.

sections.title: Where They Appear
sections.content:
• Unlocked through the story rather than recruited
  • Francois is fought at Esquie's Nest during Act 1, after Flying Waters
  • Several optional areas only open once Esquie can swim or fly - see bosses by area
  • Collect Esquie's missing rocks scattered across the map
